query_plan.query: What is the average area of South American countries?

steps.merge_task: Return the continent id and continent name of South America as soon as it is found.
steps.query: Return the continent id and continent name of South America.

dependencies.dependency: continent ids and continent names of South America

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by country id so each country appears once, then return a single value: the average area over all countries.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(countries.area_km2) AS avg_area FROM countries INNER JOIN continents ON continents.continent = countries.continent WHERE continents.name = 'South America'

s1.sql_query: SELECT continents.continent, continents.name FROM continents WHERE continents.name = 'South America'

s2.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.area_km2, countries.name FROM countries WHERE countries.continent = 18
